abstract: Gestational trophoblastic disease or neoplasia covers a spectrum of benign and malignant conditions arising from pregnancies with highly abnormal development of trophoblastic tissue. In this brief review, we discuss the different features of these different conditions and their origins and risk factors and introduce some of the more novel and controversial treatment options currently being explored.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(または妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍)は、栄養膜組織の異常な発達を伴う妊娠から生じる、良性および悪性の病態の幅広いスペクトラムを含む。本総説では、これらの異なる病態の特徴、その起源および危険因子について論じ、現在検討されている新規で議論の多い治療選択肢のいくつかを紹介する。
